## Summary
Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation
- [ ] Backend tests pass
- [ ] Frontend lint and build pass
- [ ] Docker Compose smoke test passes when applicable
- [ ] Helm lint/render passes when chart changes
- [ ] Failure/rollback behavior considered

## Security and operations
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, kubeconfigs or private keys added
- [ ] Resource requests/limits and probes reviewed for Kubernetes changes
- [ ] Database migration/backup implications reviewed
- [ ] Monitoring, alerting and runbook impact documented
- [ ] User-visible behavior and rollback plan documented
